issues.on_page: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 1,523,379 (p4-5); Statement of Activities p3: Charges for Services 1,250,036 + general receipts 273,343
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities shows 82% of this line as Charges for Services (Treasurer 160,592, Sheriff 329,462, Inheritance Tax 618,134, etc.). Under the extractor rule (category over half of a broad 'Local' line) the dominant category is charges for services/fees, not licenses and permits.

The report prints a Federal/State breakdown that adds exactly to the line (federal is 50.6%). The line could be split (split_from) into federal grants 1,990,696 and intergovernmental/state aid 1,940,064 under the 2026-11-06 mixed-label rule; kept whole with a review note.
Visitors promotion (tourism) spending; the disbursement category list puts tourism under economic development.

Schedule 2 grand totals (and single-line fund totals such as Total Highway Bridge/Road Buyback) are not in detail_totals; the lines do add to them (checked: 6,075,278 and 5,291,215 incl. transfers 307,345).
